about_the_game:
AT THE CROSSROADS OF SPIRITUAL AWE AND OPPRESSIVE DOOM

Dahla is an exile. Once a part of the psychic order ruling Titan, she had noble dreams for the moon. Now she grieves alone amidst the frozen dunes. 


Kalsang is a prodigy with the potential to cure the Gliss epidemic. But as a layman, his gifts are doomed to die in the shadow of the Convent's floating temples. 

When the Psymmularch, supreme authority of the Convent, is consumed by a violent explosion and chaos is unleashed throughout the Final Kingdom, the unlikely pair are united by opportunity. Linked by psyche and by purpose, Kalsang and Dahla leave their shattered dreams above the ice to chase a glint of hope in the nightmare below.




YOU ARE NOT ALONE

Transcendent horrors stalk the halls, relentlessly pursuing you with deceptive intelligence and their own psychic gifts. To stay alive, you’ll have to utilize the strengths of Kalsang and Dahla in tandem.

As Kalsang, hijack psionic technology, craft tools from scavenged resources, and evade enemies with dynamic mobility or cautious stealth. Weapons are scarce - and enemies never stay down for long.

As Dahla, use psychic powers to distract or detect hostiles, reveal secrets, or manipulate the environment. Unlock a growing arsenal of powers as your bond with Kalsang grows, to project your consciousness to remote locations or violently open new passageways.

PROPHECIES AND DEAD GODS 

Explore sprawling halls of the otherworldly Paladisium, uncover the nature of the ever-present crimson glow beneath you, and face the terrifying truth that emerges from the demise of a goddess. 

The fate of the human spirit lingers in below the ice, and there are many forces desperate to claim the future.

FEATURES:

  • A diverse host of enemies with dynamic, reactive, and unpredictable behavior. 

  • Audio, camera, and environment are dynamically tailored for a cinematic experience 

  • A terrifying original sci-fi world emphasizing immersion, atmosphere, and lore. 

  • Unlock and upgrade an arsenal of psychic powers, tools, and weapons. 

  • Unique puzzles, tools, and crafting specific to the world and narrative 

  • Choose to play in first person from Kalsang's perspective, or third person from Dahla's perspective 

  • Difficulty options, subtitles, and accessibility settings

content_descriptors.notes: Rogues of Titan contains references to dark topics, implies the past occurrence of violence or murder through traces of blood found in the environment, and scenes involving the player character being killed by enemies with disturbing appearances.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8/ 10, 64-bits
  • Processor: Core i3 / AMD FX 2.4Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.0, Nvidia GTX 460 / AMD
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Descend into the hellish underworld of a moon ruled by a psychic order, where transcendent horrors have broken free. Play as two outcasts as you invoke psionic powers, harness otherworldly technology, and uncover the prophesized death of a goddess.
